name: what-beats-learning
description: Spaced-repetition tutoring over remote MCP. Sign in with Google, then create and review FSRS flashcards.

interface.longDescription: What Beats Learning is a remote MCP tutor that keeps an isolated flashcard library for each Google account. After you sign in, your agent can create atomic cue-answer notes, attach pronunciation audio or study images, and run FSRS reviews. Pedagogy lives in a per-user learning-style prompt so the same tools can quiz, explain, or drill without mixing other users' data.
defaultPrompt: Quiz me on my due What Beats Learning cards.
Make a small first deck for a topic I want to learn.
Show my decks and what is due to review now.
